title: Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line Module 4 Lesson 3: Trapezium Journey Model custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A train accelerates from rest for $T\text{ s}$ at a constant rate $a$ to speed $V$, and later decelerates to rest at a constant rate $2a$. Express the time taken for the train to decelerate to rest in terms of $T$.

A train journey takes a total time of $120\text{ s}$. The train accelerates from rest for $T\text{ s}$, cruises at constant speed, and then decelerates to rest in $0.5T\text{ s}$. Find an expression in terms of $T$ for the duration of the cruising phase.

A car accelerates from rest to $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in $10\text{ s}$, cruises at $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $30\text{ s}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest in $10\text{ s}$. Find the average speed of the car over the entire journey.
A car starts from rest and moves with constant acceleration for a distance of $200\text{ m}$, reaching a speed of $25\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Find the time for which the car is accelerating.

A vehicle accelerates from rest to speed $V$ with acceleration $a$ over a distance of $50\text{ m}$, and later decelerates from speed $V$ to rest with deceleration $2a$. Find the distance travelled while decelerating.

A runner cruises at $10\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and then decelerates uniformly over the final $4\text{ s}$ of a race, covering $32\text{ m}$ to cross the finish line with speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Find the finishing speed $V$.

questions.prompt: A train travels between two stations, $A$ and $B$, which are $3300\text{ m}$ apart. The train starts from rest at $A$ and accelerates at a constant rate for $T\text{ s}$ until reaching a speed of $25\text{ m s}^{-1}$. It maintains this constant speed before decelerating uniformly to rest at $B$. The magnitude of the deceleration is twice the magnitude of the acceleration. The total journey time is $180\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find an expression in terms of $T$ for the length of time for which the train travels at constant speed, and find the value of $T$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the distance travelled by the train while it is decelerating, and find its deceleration rate.

questions.prompt: A car starts from rest at point $P$ and moves in a straight line with constant acceleration for a distance of $180\text{ m}$, reaching a speed of $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The car then travels at this speed for $600\text{ m}$, before decelerating uniformly to rest at point $Q$ over a period of $8\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the time for which the car is accelerating, and the cruising time at $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the total distance between $P$ and $Q$, and calculate the average speed of the car for the whole journey.

questions.prompt: A car starts from rest and moves in a straight line with constant acceleration $a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for a distance of $72\text{ m}$. The car then travels with constant velocity for a distance of $480\text{ m}$ over a period of $20\text{ s}$, before decelerating to rest. The magnitude of the deceleration is $2a\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the constant cruising speed $V$ and the value of $a$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the distance travelled while decelerating, the total time for which the car is in motion, and the total distance travelled.

questions.prompt: A sprinter runs a race of $200\text{ m}$ in a total time of $22\text{ s}$. He starts from rest and accelerates uniformly for $5\text{ s}$, reaching a speed of $11\text{ m s}^{-1}$. He maintains this speed for the next $12\text{ s}$, before decelerating uniformly over the final $5\text{ s}$ to cross the finish line with speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the distance travelled by the sprinter in the first $17\text{ s}$ of the race, and find the acceleration during the first $5\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the distance travelled in the final $5\text{ s}$, the value of the finishing speed $V$, and the deceleration during the final stage.

questions.prompt: Two trains, $A$ and $B$, travel along parallel straight tracks over a distance of $1800\text{ m}$ between stations $X$ and $Y$. Train $A$ accelerates uniformly at $0.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$ to $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$, cruises at $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest at $1.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$. Train $B$ accelerates uniformly at $1.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$ to $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$, cruises at $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest at $1.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the total journey time for Train $A$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the total journey time for Train $B$, and determine which train arrives earlier and by how much time.

questions.prompt: An automated metro train operates on a straight test section of length $1620\text{ m}$. The train starts from rest at station $P$ and accelerates uniformly at $1.25\text{ m s}^{-2}$ to its cruising speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$. It cruises at constant speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for a period of time, and then decelerates uniformly to rest at station $Q$ at a rate of $2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$. The total journey time from $P$ to $Q$ is $90\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Form a quadratic equation in $V$ and solve it to find the cruising speed, explaining why one mathematical solution is rejected.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the duration of each of the three stages and the distance travelled during each stage.

questions.prompt: An underground train travels between two stations $1200\text{ m}$ apart. The maximum acceleration of the train is $1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$ and its maximum deceleration is $3.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$. The train reaches top speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and does not exceed this speed.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: If the train accelerates and decelerates without any intermediate cruising stage, find the maximum speed $V_0$ reached and the total time $T_0$ taken for this non-cruising journey.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Due to track speed limits, the cruising speed is capped at $V = 30\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Calculate the total journey time $T$ and the percentage increase in journey time caused by the speed restriction.
